_about: Airbus A300 AC (Rev 22, Dec 01/09), 2.2 General Dimensions, Model B2-B4 (page index 28): layers.py --mode image at scale 5, clip 110,80,555,395 (plan), --rotate 0.25 (the sheet draws the plan turned about a quarter of a degree, the nose 7 px above the tail cone). Pixels of that raster, line centres; the upper half (the aircraft's right side, the same as its left). Ahead of the wing the fuselage side runs along the 5.64 m dimension's extension line. The flap-track fairings stand behind the trailing edge: the edge is the straight line from the tip to the unswept inboard trailing edge. The nacelle hides the leading edge (hidden). The nacelle's sides aren't traced: its plan draws the nacelle's middle 8.07 m out against the printed 15.87 m apart; the front view's inlet (7.94 m) places it.
